article.story: DALLAS -- — Billy White III scored 23 points off the bench, and SMU rallied from an eight-point halftime deficit to beat Oral Roberts 76-72 on Tuesday night. White made 8 of 10 shots, including 6 of 8 from 3-point range, for the Mustangs (5-0). Oziyah Sellers added 16 points, and Jermaine O’Neal Jr. scored 12. Oral Roberts led 31-23 at halftime and held a 36-32 lead early in the second half before SMU answered. White’s 3-pointer with 14:15 remaining gave the Mustangs a 37-36 lead. The teams then traded baskets down the stretch. Boden Williams hit a 3-pointer with 2:27 left to put Oral Roberts ahead 71-68, but White answered with a 3 on the next possession to tie it once again. Nic Codie then hit a 3-pointer with 1:38 remaining to give SMU a 74-71 lead. Oral Roberts got within two on a Williams free throw but missed two potential tying 3-pointers in the closing seconds. David Terrell Jr. finished with 14 assists for SMU, which shot 50% from the field and 48% from 3-point range. Williams led Oral Roberts (2-3) with 22 points, eight rebounds and six assists. Luke Gray added 14 points. Up next SMU: Hosts South Alabama on Friday. Oral Roberts: Plays Texas A&M-Corpus Christi at home this Saturday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
